open_with: Open by acknowledging the depth of sustainability screening work she's clearly put in—invite her to walk you through her current framework or criteria so the conversation builds on her own diligence rather than re-explaining basics. Since she's been a client since July 2024, frame this as a continuing dialogue, not an onboarding check-in.
do_not_lead_with: Do not lead with generic ESG disclaimers, simplified explanations of sustainability screening concepts, or overly cautious risk-hedging language—she does her own research and will find this condescending. Also avoid opening with any performance or portfolio figure cold, since no specific finding or number was provided in the brief to anchor it.
one_number: No specific figure was provided in the findings—flag internally that none should be cited or invented; if a number comes up in conversation, source it live from her portfolio system rather than guessing.
